messages:
Sofia M (Sales): Quick heads-up 1 - Prospect 'ClearBridge' needs a compact assurance bundle for their execs before we sign the SOW. They asked for: SOC2 excerpt, ISO certificate, pen-test attestation letter, and a short note on whether Dedicated affects price/lead time. Can we confirm what we can share and timing?

Ravi K (Solutions Eng): I can gather most of this. Typical lightweight bundle I send: 
- SOC2 Type II summary PDF (redact dates if needed)
- ISO27001 cert scan (PDF)
- Signed pen-test attestation (template)
- Short ops note on Dedicated impact (cost + provisioning ETA)
- Staging network diagram (sanitized)

Tess H (Security): We have a one-page pen-test attestation template. It needs Customer "TO:" line. Redactions OK for internal IPs. We can sign within 48 hours after we have the recipient name.

Lena D (Legal): Legal signs the attestation as "Redwood Inference, Inc. Legal Counsel (on behalf of Security)". I need the recipient legal entity name and email to include on the letter. We also require the customer confirm they accept our template (simple ack).

Omar J (Infra): Note: Dedicated introduces static egress and optional VPC peering. Typical uplift: $6,800/month + one-time setup $3,800 for a 2-GPU pool. Provisioning lead time ~7 business days after PO. If they stay on hosted, nothing changes. Also need a 4-hour external scan window; prefer Tue morning UTC.

Sofia M (Sales): Great. Can someone post the bundle to a read-only dataroom link so I can send to ClearBridge? They want reply today. Also add the Dedicated uplift + ETA text so I can include pricing.

Ravi K (Solutions Eng): Will upload to Assurance workspace and post link here in 30m. I'll include a small README with what to upload (presigned instructions).

AssuranceBot: Assurance workspace created: https://dataroom.redwood/assurance/CLEARBRIDGE-5601234567 (view-only). Uploaded: SOC2-summary.pdf, ISO27001-cert.pdf, pen-test-template.docx (unsigned).

Tess H (Security): Added: note on redaction policy and what we redact. Once customer provides TO: line I'll get the attestation signed within 48h.

Lena D (Legal): I can prepare the signed letter once they confirm recipient. Will sign within 48h after that.

Omar J (Infra): Confirming Dedicated uplift + lead time: $6,800/mo, $3,800 one-time, provisioning ~7 business days after PO. Scan window preference: Tue 08:00-12:00 UTC.

Sofia M (Sales): Thanks team. I'll message ClearBridge now: will include dataroom link, note that signed pen-test letter will be ready within 48h after they confirm recipient TO:, and Dedicated pricing/lead time as above. I'll report back when they reply. :pray:
